name: Neoklan Flexible Product Pricing for WooCommerce
author: neoklan

sections.description:
Neoklan Flexible Product Pricing for WooCommerce lets store owners allow shoppers to enter their own price for a product, instead of a fixed price. This is useful for:

  • Donations
  • Gift cards
  • Pay-what-you-want offers
  • Variable bill or invoice payments

Features

  • Enable flexible, customer-set pricing per simple product, or per variation on a variable product.
  • Optional minimum and maximum price limits, enforced both in the browser and on the server.
  • The existing Regular Price field is reused as the suggested price shown to customers.
  • The customer’s chosen price carries through the cart, checkout, order emails, and the order-edit screen.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Requirements

This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active. It currently supports simple and variable products only (no Subscriptions, Bundles, or Deposits integration).

Privacy

If you deactivate this plugin and choose “Submit & Deactivate” on the feedback prompt, your selected reason, any optional details you type, and your site’s URL are emailed to the plugin developer (Neoklan Technologies, info@neoklan.com) so we can improve the plugin. Choosing “Skip & Deactivate” sends nothing. No other data is collected by this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Edit a product, check “Flexible Pricing” on the General tab (or per variation for variable products), and optionally set a minimum/maximum price.
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes. Enable “Flexible Pricing” and set min/max on individual variations via the Variations tab.

What price is shown as the suggested price?

The product’s existing Regular Price field is used as the suggested price — there is no separate field to configure.

Does this support Subscriptions or Bundles?

Not currently. This plugin is scoped to simple and variable products only.
